verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents the building blocks a coding agent backend needs: an OpenAI-compatible API that existing clients can point at, an Anthropic Messages API described as compatible with Claude clients, and OpenAI-style function and tool calling across backends. However, no evidence names a coding agent connected to it or documents a setup for one. missing for 10: explicit documentation of connecting coding agents (e.g. setup guides for specific agents), hands-on or independent confirmation that coding-agent tool-call loops work reliably against LocalAI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
